diagnosis: EmailAttachmentDownloadView retrieves and serves email attachments directly by attachment_id for any logged-in user. The view performs no checks against the parent Email object's recipient or sender organization, enabling authenticated users to download private attachments such as PDF contracts, receipts, and medical reports sent to other platform users.
exploit_request:
GET /api/mail/attachments/7391/download/ HTTP/1.1
Host: app.finhealth.com
Cookie: sessionid=valid_user_session
Accept: */*
